Credits

Hollowmere

An original creature-friendship adventure. Every character, place, tune and story here was made for this game.

Design and direction: Benjamin Llados. Built with Claude.

Models, textures, music and sound are generated by the game from its own data, so there are no outside art or audio files. 3D rendering uses the open-source three.js library (MIT licence).

Starring Tumbl, Old Wick, Tally, Nan Nougat, Bellows, Bramble, Hum, Lumi, Capella, Ripplet, Captain Brine, Thimble, Gale, Lull, and everyone else at the Fair.
